svg.title: Six weak spots at a glance
svg.desc: 1. The app answers anyone who can reach it: Anyone on your Wi-Fi, or online, can use, delete or replace your models and use your ollama.com account. Fix: keep Ollama on 127.0.0.1 (the default).; 2. Older versions have known holes: Published bugs let others crash it, read its memory or, in old versions, take over the computer. Fix: update Ollama to 0.40.8 or later.; 3. A model file carries more than the model: Its template and settings can be outdated, rewritten by an uploader, or tampered with. Fix: get models from the maker or Ollama's library.; 4. The layout can change what the model reads: 32 of 43 library models read tool chats differently; qwen2.5 got 45 fewer of 1,240 tool questions right. Fix: test tool use on the exact model you ship.; 5. Helpers turn the model's words into actions: Text hidden in a page or file can steer the helper into reading or sending your files. Fix: one folder, no secrets in it, approve risky steps.; 6. Your chats are kept as ordinary files: Backups, sync tools and anyone using your account can read your saved conversations. Fix: delete old chats; set OLLAMA_NOHISTORY=1.
svg.text: Six weak spots at a glance
What can go wrong in a local AI setup, and the fix that matters most for each.
The app answers anyone who can reach it
Anyone on your Wi-Fi, or online, can use, delete or
replace your models and use your ollama.com account.
Fix: keep Ollama on 127.0.0.1 (the default)
Older versions have known holes
Published bugs let others crash it, read its memory
or, in old versions, take over the computer.
Fix: update Ollama to 0.40.8 or later
A model file carries more than the model
Its template and settings can be outdated, rewritten
by an uploader, or tampered with.
Fix: get models from the maker or Ollama's library
The layout can change what the model reads
32 of 43 library models read tool chats differently;
qwen2.5 got 45 fewer of 1,240 tool questions right.
Fix: test tool use on the exact model you ship
Helpers turn the model's words into actions
Text hidden in a page or file can steer the helper
into reading or sending your files.
Fix: one folder, no secrets in it, approve risky steps
Your chats are kept as ordinary files
Backups, sync tools and anyone using your account
can read your saved conversations.
Fix: delete old chats; set OLLAMA_NOHISTORY=1
Each one is explained below, with how to check it on your own computer.
